chunks: They do not esteem God with the right estimation. God is surely all-powerful and all-mighty.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'not esteem God with the right estimation' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a critique of humanity's limited capacity to comprehend the divine essence, emphasizing that God's true majesty surpasses all human conceptualization. It serves as a theological anchor for the concept of God's absolute sovereignty, reminding believers that His power is not contingent upon human perception or estimation. This affirmation of divine might reinforces the necessity of humble submission and deep reverence in worship.
